claims.claim: recoverToolInvocation replays a verified safe/safe effect_pending call once when the run is not cancelled; the blanket never-replay short-circuit is gone
the old durable checkpoint is cleared before the replayed invocation starts
the replayed outcome is published only after performToolInvocation completes, via .then(publishToolOutcome(...))
unsafe, missing and cancelled declarations keep the interruption path that reads the checkpoint and synthesizes interruptedOutcome
regression drives the real production module through the read-only VM harness and asserts replay ordering plus the retained conditional restrictions

validation.notes: Ran from the workspace root with Node v24.14.0 (VM Modules + stripTypeScriptTypes). The script loads the real packages/agent/src/harness/runtime/drive/tools.ts through .prale-eval/subject.mjs createRecoverySubject, so only checkpoint IO, the tool effect and outcome publication are faked. On the repaired source it exits 0: recover('safe','safe',false) yields events ['clear','invoke','effect-complete','publish'] with exactly one clear/invoke/publish, cleared arguments {persisted:42} reaching the invocation, a fresh non-interrupted result, recovery=true, and publication strictly after effect completion; recover('safe','unsafe'), ('never','safe'), ('never','unsafe'), missing tool (undefined), absent policy (null), and cancelled ('safe','safe',true) each yield events ['read','publish'] with the durable 'durable-progress' content plus the interruption marker, details {step:2}, isError=true, no clear/invoke, so the conditional restrictions are retained. Negative control: a scratch copy of the same file with the original `if (false && ...)` guard reintroduced at line 527 was loaded via PRALE_RECOVERY_ROOT; the patch was confirmed to hit exactly once and the script exited 1 with AssertionError 'safe replay must not read the stale checkpoint as its outcome' (actual 1, expected 0), then the scratch copy was removed and the repaired workspace re-run green. Limitation: node_modules is absent, so no tsc/biome/vitest run was possible; type-level verification relied on explicit `tool !== undefined && tool.replay === 'safe'` narrowing, and behavioral verification on the Node 24 VM regression above.
